d: Mike Connors reprises his former role as tough-guy PI Joe Mannix, who gets assistance from Dr. Sloan to tackle an unsolved 1973 murder case.
The investigation of a country star's murder revolves around a driven TV producer (Barbara Mandrell) and her daughter, a timid songwriter.
A psychiatrist murders his estranged wife and frames a patient for the crime.
A sultry but sinister pharmaceutical rep is dead set on winning the heart of the hospital's chief of staff.
A beach boy involved with a gang member's sister is a suspect in his murder.
A surgeon (Wayne Rogers) drops dead while he's operating on another doctor (Jack Klugman).
A pilot of an airliner carrying Dr. Sloan and Amanda to a medical conference in Europe is murdered.
A wealthy woman and her lover concoct an elaborate scheme to do in her husband.
A comedian (Tim Conway) makes a bumbling attempt to do in his more successful former partner (Harvey Korman)---whose wife turns up dead.
A mad bomber whom Dr. Sloan helped put away has escaped and wants the good doctor blown away.
Steve becomes embroiled in political intrigue after the murder of a city councilman's wife appears to be part of a larger political strategy.
Mark investigates when her older lover, a new state Supreme Court Justice, murders a teenage girl.

A Malibu Hills fire is the backdrop for rising tensions between the residents; a disgraced stockbroker, a naturalist, a worried father, and a land developer. A worried Dr. Sloan deals with his own parental fears when Steve helps fight the fire.

Community General is already under increased security, with a high-profile criminal hospitalized, when an important businesswoman is brought in. Mark suspects her security guard has deadly intentions.
Jesse's new part-time job as a trainer of the pro basketball Mustangs turns deadly when he's accused of murdering a star player.
Dr. Sloan investigates a plastic surgeon when an actress's death apparently results from an infection contracted during surgery.
Mark and Amanda are assigned to the task force investigating an airplane crash. An adversarial FBI agent and Russian mobsters make their assignment more difficult.
Steve and Ron lead the chase for the stolen nuclear material.
